_comment: Flat bench plate: 6 x VL53L5CX all facing forward in parallel. Origin = plate centre (between the rows, middle column); x forward, y right, z up, metres. Rows: S1 S2 S3 (top) / S4 S5 S6 (bottom), seen from behind. 2.5 cm between neighbours in a row, 4 cm between rows. Bottom row is mounted rotated 180 deg (roll 180). If the plate is worn, add the plate-to-head-centre offset to every x_m/z_m.
